title: AWS access key id
note: Looks like a long-lived AWS access key in source. Rotate it and load it from the environment.

title: GitHub token
note: A GitHub token in source. Revoke it; use a secret store or an installation token.

title: OpenAI-style API key
note: Looks like an API key literal. Rotate it and read it from the environment.

title: Slack token
note: A Slack token in source. Revoke it and use a secret store.

title: Stripe secret key
note: A Stripe secret key in source. Roll it in the Stripe dashboard.

title: Private key material
note: A private key block in source. Remove it from history and rotate the key.

title: Hardcoded credential
note: A credential-looking literal assigned to a secret-named variable. Read it from the environment or a secret store.

title: TLS verification disabled
note: Certificate checks are turned off, so any network hop can impersonate the server. Fix the trust store instead.

title: Shell command built from strings
note: A shell command assembled from runtime values. Pass arguments as a list (no shell) or validate them.

title: eval / dynamic code execution
note: Executes code from a string. Almost always avoidable; if the input can come from outside, it is remote code execution.

title: SQL built by string concatenation
re: "\s*(SELECT|INSERT INTO|UPDATE|DELETE FROM)\b[^"]*"\s*\+\s*[a-zA-Z_]|'\s*(SELECT|INSERT INTO|UPDATE|DELETE FROM)\b[^']*'\s*\+\s*[a-zA-Z_]|f["'](SELECT|INSERT INTO|UPDATE|DELETE FROM)\b[^"']*\{|(SELECT|INSERT INTO|UPDATE|DELETE FROM)\b[^"'`]*\$\{
note: Query text is built from values. Use parameters or a query builder; this is the classic injection shape.

title: Raw HTML injection
note: HTML is rendered from a value. If any part can come from a user, this is cross-site scripting.

title: Unsafe deserialization
note: Deserializes untrusted bytes into objects; a crafted payload runs code. Use a safe loader or a data-only format.

title: World-writable permissions
note: Everyone on the host can write this path. Use the narrowest mode that works.

title: CORS open to any origin
note: Any site can call this API from a browser. Fine for public read-only data; wrong for anything with credentials.

title: Weak hash for a password
note: MD5/SHA-1 are not password hashes. Use bcrypt, scrypt or Argon2.

title: Non-cryptographic randomness for a secret
note: Math.random / random are predictable. Use crypto.randomBytes, crypto.getRandomValues or secrets.

title: Git hooks bypassed
note: Skips pre-commit/pre-push hooks, including the checks that would have caught the rest of this list.

title: Wildcard IAM policy
note: Grants everything on everything. Scope the action and resource.

title: Debug mode enabled
note: Debug mode leaks stack traces and, in Flask, an interactive console. Drive it from the environment.

title: .env file added
note: An environment file was added to the repository. It usually holds secrets; keep it in .gitignore.
